description: [Paid-only, $0.05 USDC per call: this free MCP tool returns payment instructions, not a result. Get the result from POST https://api.kkuldogu.com/v1/financial-income-tax with x402.] South Korea comprehensive taxation of financial income (interest and dividends over 20 million KRW a year): compares the comprehensive method (first 20M at 14%, the excess added to other income at 6-45%) with the 14% separate method and takes the larger, then shows tax due beyond what was withheld. Dividend gross-up and the 2026 high-dividend separate-taxation option are not modeled.

financialIncome.description: Total interest and dividend income for the year, before tax (KRW)

otherTaxBase.description: Tax base of other comprehensive income (after deductions), e.g. wage or business income; default 0 (KRW)
